overwrite.tooltip: If enabled, existing files will be overwritten. If disabled, a numbered suffix is added.

normalize_clipping.tooltip: If enabled, peak-normalizes clipped audio. If disabled, 24-bit PCM hard-clips to -1 dBFS while 32-bit float saves over-full-scale samples.

SaveAudioWithPath.name: SaveAudioWithPath
SaveAudioWithPath.description: Saves audio to a specified folder with a subfolder as an uncompressed WAV file.

remove_extension.tooltip: Remove file extension from output name

frames_limit.tooltip: Maximum number of output frames. Use -1 to load the complete video.

framerate.tooltip: -1 keeps the source rate. Lower values retain evenly spaced frames; values above the source rate keep the source rate.

even_batch_picker.tooltip: After Frames limit, retain this many frames evenly across that range using the same selection as Even Batch Picker (CRT). -1 or 0 keeps the complete limited range.

megapixels.tooltip: After even-frame selection, resize only the retained frames to this target area with Lanczos while preserving aspect ratio.

folder_path.tooltip: Base folder path to save the file

subfolder_name.tooltip: Subfolder name within the base folder

filename.tooltip: File name (without extension). Leave empty to number files incrementally starting at 0.

overwrite.tooltip: If enabled, existing files will be overwritten. If disabled, a numbered suffix like _001 is added.

SaveLatentsConditioning.name: SaveLatentsConditioning
SaveLatentsConditioning.description: Saves a latent and a conditioning together in a single .safetensors file. Load them back with 'Load Latents Conditioning (CRT)'.

LoadLatentsConditioning.name: LoadLatentsConditioning
LoadLatentsConditioning.description: Loads a latent + conditioning pair saved with 'Save Latents Conditioning (CRT)', selected by seed. If an audio file with the same name sits next to the .safetensors file, it is returned on the 'audio' output (None when no matching audio exists).

CRT_AddSettingsAndPrompt.name: CRT_AddSettingsAndPrompt
CRT_AddSettingsAndPrompt.description:
Adds a text block with settings and a prompt to an image,
either horizontally at the bottom or vertically on the right.
The block's size is dynamically adjusted to fit the text.
Fonts are loaded from: ComfyUI/custom_nodes/CRT-Nodes/Fonts

batch_count.tooltip: Number of items to generate with different seeds. Higher values = more VRAM in parallel mode.

model_high_noise.tooltip: Model used for the initial high-noise denoising phase. Typically handles structure and composition.

model_low_noise.tooltip: Model used for the final low-noise refinement phase. Typically handles details and fine features.

positive.tooltip: Positive prompt conditioning. Describes what you want to generate.

width.tooltip: Output width in pixels. Will be quantized to nearest multiple of 16.

height.tooltip: Output height in pixels. Will be quantized to nearest multiple of 16.

frame_count.tooltip: Number of frames to generate. Use 1 for images, >1 for videos.

seed.tooltip: Starting seed for generation. Each batch item uses seed+N if increment is enabled.

increment_seed.tooltip: If enabled, each batch item gets seed+1, seed+2, etc. If disabled, all use the same seed.

steps.tooltip: Total number of denoising steps. More steps = better quality but slower generation.

boundary.tooltip: Sigma value where switching from high-noise to low-noise model occurs. Lower = earlier switch.

sigma_shift.tooltip: Shifts the noise schedule. Higher values = more denoising emphasis on high-frequency details.

cfg_high_noise.tooltip: Classifier-Free Guidance scale for high-noise phase. Higher = stronger prompt adherence.

cfg_low_noise.tooltip: Classifier-Free Guidance scale for low-noise phase. Higher = stronger prompt adherence.

sampler_name.tooltip: Sampling algorithm. Different samplers have different quality/speed tradeoffs.

scheduler.tooltip: Noise schedule that controls how denoising steps are distributed.

enable_vae_decode.tooltip: Decode latents to images. Disable to only output latents.

create_comparison_grid.tooltip: Create a side-by-side comparison grid of all batch outputs.

save_videos_images.tooltip: Save outputs to disk. Disable to only use outputs in workflow.

save_folder_path.tooltip: Root folder where outputs will be saved.

save_subfolder_name.tooltip: Subfolder name inside the root folder for organizing outputs.

save_filename_prefix.tooltip: Prefix for output filenames. Seed will be appended automatically.

fps.tooltip: Frames per second for video outputs. Only relevant when frame_count > 1.

processing_mode.tooltip: Parallel = process all batches together (fast, high VRAM). Sequential = one at a time (slow, low VRAM).

offload_conditioning.tooltip: Offload text conditioning to CPU between items. Reduces VRAM slightly, forces sequential mode.

negative.tooltip: Optional negative conditioning. If disconnected, empty negative conditioning is auto-generated from positive.

vae.tooltip: VAE model for encoding/decoding. Required if enable_vae_decode is True or using I2V mode.

start_image.tooltip: Starting image for Image-to-Video generation. When provided, switches to I2V mode automatically.

Batch Randomize.tooltip: Shuffle without repeats across incrementing seeds. Every file is presented once before a new shuffled cycle begins. No cache is stored. Disabled keeps consecutive selection.

weighted_phrases.tooltip: Shared KREA2 weights applied to every selected prompt. Use (phrase:-1) to suppress or (phrase:1.5) to emphasize. The phrase must occur in the prompt.

strength.tooltip: Global multiplier for the shared weighting effect. Use sampler CFG 1.0 with KREA2.

Batch Randomize.tooltip: Shuffle without repeats across incrementing seeds. Every file is presented before a new cycle begins.

CRT_FileBatchPromptSchedulerKREA2.name: CRT_FileBatchPromptSchedulerKREA2
CRT_FileBatchPromptSchedulerKREA2.description: Loads a scheduled batch of prompt files, applies one shared set of KREA2 phrase weights to the whole batch, and returns the patched model. Use CFG 1.0.

folder_path.tooltip: Path to the folder containing the text files

batch_count.tooltip: Number of files to load in the batch

seed.tooltip: Acts as a batch offset. Set to 0 to start from the first file.

file_extension.tooltip: The file extension to filter for (e.g., .txt)

max_words.tooltip: Maximum number of words per output (0 for no limit)

crawl_subfolders.tooltip: Whether to include files in subfolders

max_side_length.tooltip: The absolute maximum size (in pixels) for either the width or height of the final image.

consolidate_lines.tooltip: If True, removes line breaks within each individual string input

join_with.tooltip: 'Newline' for 'return to line' behavior between strings

suffix.tooltip: Character(s) to add to the end of each string before joining

save_to_file.tooltip: Enable to save each processed string as a .txt file

file_path.tooltip: The directory within the main output folder to save the .txt files to

filename_prefix.tooltip: The prefix for the saved filenames

text.default:
Paragraph 1...

Paragraph 2...

split_symbol.tooltip: A custom character or string to split by. If empty, splits by empty lines.

strip_whitespace.tooltip: Remove leading/trailing whitespace from each split part

increment_seed.tooltip: If enabled, each batch item gets seed+1, seed+2, etc. If disabled, all items use the same seed.

image_megapixels.tooltip: Target resolution in megapixels. Images are resized (lanczos) preserving aspect ratio and quantized to VAE boundaries before encoding.

edit_model_flux2klein.tooltip: Enable ReferenceLatent-style conditioning for edit/fill models (flux2klein). Forces denoise=1 and samples from an empty latent. Requires image input.

reference_mode.tooltip: per_item: each image in the batch is used as its own reference latent. shared: image[0] is used as the reference for every batch item.

enable_vae_decode.tooltip: Decode latents to images using the VAE.

create_comparison_grid.tooltip: Create a horizontal side-by-side comparison grid of all batch outputs.

save_folder_path.tooltip: Root folder where outputs will be saved.

save_subfolder_name.tooltip: Subfolder inside the root folder for organizing outputs.

save_filename_prefix.tooltip: Prefix for output filenames. Seed is appended automatically.

latent_image.tooltip: Starting latent. If image is also connected, image takes priority. If neither input is connected, a dummy empty latent is auto-generated using VAE channel info.

image.tooltip: Input image batch. Resized to image_megapixels before encoding. In normal mode: VAE-encoded as the starting latent. In edit_model_flux2klein mode: used as reference latent; sampling starts from an empty latent.

increment_seed.tooltip: Each batch item gets seed+1, seed+2, etc. Disable to use same seed for all.

image_megapixels.tooltip: Target resolution in megapixels. Images are resized (lanczos) preserving aspect ratio.

edit_model_flux2klein.tooltip: Enable ReferenceLatent-style conditioning for edit/fill models (flux2klein).

reference_mode.tooltip: per_item: each image is its own reference. shared: image[0] is reference for all.

enable_vae_decode.tooltip: Decode latents to images using the VAE.

create_comparison_grid.tooltip: Create a horizontal side-by-side comparison grid.

latent_image.tooltip: Starting latent. If image is also connected, image takes priority. If neither is connected, a dummy empty latent is auto-generated.

image.tooltip: Input image batch. Resized to image_megapixels before encoding. In edit_model_flux2klein mode: used as reference latent.

text.tooltip: Displays and passes through the connected string. When passthrough is not connected, this editable text is returned.

passthrough.tooltip: Optional connected string to display and return unchanged.

frames.tooltip: MiniMax-H3 frame count at 24 fps. Valid values are 17*n+5 (5 to 362). Official range is 124-362 (5-15 s); shorter runs but is out-of-distribution.

CRT_MinimaxLength.name: CRT_MinimaxLength
CRT_MinimaxLength.description: Frame count snapped to MiniMax-H3's valid grid (17n+5, 24 fps, 5-15 s).

model.tooltip: The diffusion model to patch with the selected LoRA.

lora_folder.tooltip: Folder relative to models/loras, or an absolute folder. Only LoRA files directly inside it are considered.

seed.tooltip: Selects the LoRA by seed modulo sorted LoRA count. Use ComfyUI's fixed, increment, decrement, or randomize control.

strength_model.tooltip: Strength applied to the diffusion model.

PGC_SeededPersonaLoraLoader.name: PGC_SeededPersonaLoraLoader
PGC_SeededPersonaLoraLoader.description: Selects a LoRA deterministically from a folder using a native ComfyUI seed control, applies it to MODEL, and outputs its same-stem markdown persona as a string. Works with any model architecture.
output_tooltips: The model with the selected LoRA applied.
Contents of the .md file whose stem matches the selected LoRA.

fade_duration.tooltip: Fade duration in seconds for fade_loop mode

start_level.tooltip: Brightness at the very first frame.

mid_level.tooltip: Brightness at the exact center of the video.

end_level.tooltip: Brightness at the very last frame.

q_factor.tooltip: Curve Shape. 1.0=Linear, 2.0=Parabolic (Smooth). Higher values = Stays closer to Mid Level longer.

ReferenceLatentBatch.name: ReferenceLatentBatch
ReferenceLatentBatch.description: Accepts a batch of latent images and registers each frame as a separate reference, equivalent to chaining N ReferenceLatent nodes. Frames are sorted by full-content hash before registration so that any permutation of the same images produces byte-identical conditioning.

model_union_control.tooltip: Optional V2V Depth Control: model already merged with UnionControl / IC-LoRA guide support.

model_outpaint.tooltip: Optional V2V Outpaint mode model merged with IC-LoRA Outpaint.

model_upscale.tooltip: Optional V2V Upscale mode model merged with IC-LoRA Upscale.

spatial_upscale_model.tooltip: Optional latent upscaler used by HQ generation and V2V Upscale mode.

da3_model.tooltip: Depth Anything V3 model used to build V2V depth guides when no precomputed depth override is connected.

latent_downscale_factor.tooltip: Compression/downscale factor reported by the latent upscaler LoRA. Connect the loader output rather than guessing this value.

CRT_LTX23USModelsPipe.name: CRT_LTX23USModelsPipe
CRT_LTX23USModelsPipe.description: Bundles the LTX 2.3 model, video/audio VAEs, CLIP, and optional mode-specific models for the unified sampler.

Image I2V / V2V FirstFrame.tooltip: Starting image for I2V, or an optional first-frame anchor for V2V.

Video (V2V image batch).tooltip: Input video represented as an IMAGE batch. Required for V2V modes.

V2V Depth (override).tooltip: Optional precomputed depth guide for V2V Depth Control. When connected, skips DepthAnything inference.

source_audio.tooltip: Optional source audio used for conditioning and, when enabled, to derive the output frame count.

MegaPixels (override).tooltip: Values above 0 override the sampler megapixels_target; 0 keeps the sampler setting.

Frames (override).tooltip: Values above 0 override the sampler frame_count; 0 keeps the sampler setting.

Width T2V (override).tooltip: T2V width override. Use 0 to derive dimensions from megapixels and aspect ratio.

Height T2V (override).tooltip: T2V height override. Use 0 to derive dimensions from megapixels and aspect ratio.

HQ (override).tooltip: Config-pipe HQ override. When true it enables HQ even if the sampler widget is off.

CRT_LTX23USConfig.name: CRT_LTX23USConfig
CRT_LTX23USConfig.description: Collects the prompt, seed, optional image/video/audio inputs, and per-workflow overrides for the unified sampler.

workflow_mode.tooltip: Select image-to-video, text-to-video, or video-to-video execution. Required config inputs depend on this mode.

hq.tooltip: Generate directly at full resolution in one sampling pass for maximum quality. Disable HQ to use the faster two-stage path: half-resolution generation followed by latent upscale and refinement.

live_preview.tooltip: Decode intermediate previews during sampling. Useful for monitoring but adds decode overhead.

frame_count_from_audio.tooltip: When source audio is connected, derive the video length from its duration instead of frame_count.

vae_decode_tiled.tooltip: Decode video latents in tiles to reduce peak VRAM at the cost of additional processing time.

unload_model_before_vae_decode.tooltip: Unload the diffusion model after sampling and before VAE decode to reduce decode-time VRAM.

low_vram.tooltip: Unload CLIP after conditioning and VAEs before sampling, then reload VAEs for decode. Depth Anything V3 is always unloaded immediately after depth estimation.

megapixels_target.tooltip: Target output area in megapixels before model-specific dimension quantization.

frame_count.tooltip: Requested output length. LTX requires 8k+1 frames; invalid values are normalized automatically and reported in the console.

v2v_mode.tooltip: Depth Control follows scene depth; Outpaint expands the canvas; Upscale performs guided video enlargement. Each optional mode needs its matching model pipe input.

v2v_guide_strength.tooltip: Strength of the V2V depth guide. Higher values follow the source structure more closely.

depth_megapixels.tooltip: Resolution used only for DA3 depth estimation. DA3 is offloaded before the main V2V sampler starts.

steps.tooltip: Legacy compatibility value. LTX 2.3 distilled inference now always uses its fixed trained sigma schedule.

generated_audio_gain_db.tooltip: Gain applied to generated audio after decode, in decibels.

firstframe_strength.tooltip: Influence of the connected first-frame anchor. Zero disables anchoring; one applies full strength.

depth_cache_mode.tooltip: V2V Depth Control only. Disable reuse, keep the latest DA3 depth frames in RAM, or store them in ComfyUI's session temp directory. Temp files are cleared by ComfyUI at startup and graceful shutdown.

what_to_detect.tooltip: Text prompt used for subject detection, for example 'face' or 'person'.

performance_preset.tooltip: Fast = quickest detection, Balanced = default tradeoff, Quality = highest available quality in the current custom-node path and slower processing. The SAM path still uses a model-safe square working resolution.

single_item.tooltip: Limit detection to one item per frame. Enable this when you only want the main face/subject.

detect_chunk_size.tooltip: Detection batch size. 0 = process the whole batch at once, 1 = per-image processing, 2+ = fixed chunk size.

padding.tooltip: Extra border added around the input batch before detection so subjects near the edges are not cropped too tightly.

threshold.tooltip: Detection confidence threshold. Lower values find more masks, higher values are stricter.

bbox_expansion.tooltip: Expands the detected crop box around the subject. Higher values give a looser crop.

crop_smooth_alpha.tooltip: Temporal smoothing for crop position. Lower = steadier crop, higher = follows motion more closely.

crop_megapixels.tooltip: Target resolution for the cropped output images. 0 disables crop rescaling.

resize_back_to_original.tooltip: If disabled, upscale the original canvas to keep enhanced crop detail

what_to_detect.tooltip: Text prompt used by CLIPSeg, for example 'face' or 'person'.

performance_preset.tooltip: Fast = quickest detection, Balanced = default tradeoff, Quality = highest available quality in the current custom-node path and slower processing.

detect_chunk_size.tooltip: Detection batch size. 0 = process the whole batch at once, 1 = per-image processing, 2+ = fixed chunk size.

padding.tooltip: Extra border added around the input batch before detection so subjects near the edges are not cropped too tightly.

threshold.tooltip: Detection confidence threshold. Lower values find more mask areas, higher values are stricter.

blur_sigma.tooltip: Optional blur applied to CLIPSeg masks before crop extraction.

bbox_expansion.tooltip: Expands the detected crop box around the subject. Higher values give a looser crop.

crop_smooth_alpha.tooltip: Temporal smoothing for crop position. Lower = steadier crop, higher = follows motion more closely.

crop_megapixels.tooltip: Target resolution for the cropped output images. 0 disables crop rescaling.

Threshold.tooltip: Images with a rounded score strictly greater than this value are returned and optionally saved.

Path Save If above threshold.tooltip: Optional output folder for images above Threshold. Relative paths are resolved below ComfyUI/output; leave empty to disable saving.

attention_backend.tooltip: Attention implementation used when loading ERNIE. Auto prefers FlashAttention 2 when installed and compatible, otherwise eager attention.

keep_model_loaded.tooltip: Keep the model resident on the active device after scoring for faster subsequent runs at the cost of VRAM.

offload_to_cpu.tooltip: When keep_model_loaded is off, retain the cached model on CPU instead of releasing it completely. This reduces reload time but uses system RAM.

ErnieImageAestheticScore.name: ErnieImageAestheticScore
ErnieImageAestheticScore.description: Scores each input image from 0 to 100 with baidu/ERNIE-Image-Aes. Returns parallel INT and STRING lists in batch order, plus the highest-scoring image and the batch scoring above Threshold. The model downloads on first use.

image.tooltip: Optional image batch. The model loaded in Unsloth Studio must support vision input.

unsloth_server_url.tooltip: Leave the default to discover Studio's active local llama-server port from its logs. Enter a reachable non-default llama-server base URL to bypass discovery. Studio must have a model loaded; image input requires a vision-capable model.

skills_path.tooltip: Optional directory with skill files. Every .md file in the folder and its subfolders is loaded recursively and appended to the system prompt as extra context.

disable_thinking.tooltip: Request a direct answer by disabling supported model thinking mode. Models that ignore this chat-template option are unaffected.

include_reasoning.tooltip: Append reasoning_content returned by the server to the response output when the loaded model provides it.

reuse_context.tooltip: Keep the system prompt and skill files in the llama-server slot cache between runs: only the new user content (image + prompt) is evaluated, making repeated runs much faster. Editing the system prompt or a skill file changes the prefix and automatically rebuilds the cache once.

clear_prompt_cache.tooltip: Erase llama-server slot 0 after generation, forcing the next run to reprocess the full prompt. Leave off to keep context reuse.

UnslothLLM.name: UnslothLLM
UnslothLLM.description: Connects ComfyUI to the model currently loaded in Unsloth Studio. Unsloth Studio must remain open; image input requires a vision model.

keep_blocks.tooltip: Comma-separated block indexes to keep in the saved LoRA. Empty = save all blocks. Supports ranges like 0-13,16,17,26,27.

rank.tooltip: SVD rank for compression. 0 = lossless diff format (larger file). >0 = LoRA format with SVD at this rank.

enable_translation.tooltip: Translate the Whisper transcript with the optional local llama.cpp runtime. Requires a separately installed llama-cpp-python package.

translation_language.tooltip: Target language used when translation is enabled and for translated OmniVoice output.

mode.tooltip: Choose how the output size is decided: preset ratio, manual width/height, or the input image ratio.

ratio_preset.tooltip: Target aspect ratio used in Preset Ratio mode.

megapixels.tooltip: Target total image size in megapixels for automatic sizing modes.

width.tooltip: Manual or fallback output width in pixels.

height.tooltip: Manual or fallback output height in pixels.

divisible_by.tooltip: Round the final size to a model-safe multiple such as 16 or 32.

resize_method.tooltip: Choose center crop, draggable crop-position, or fit/letterbox behavior when resizing an input image.

interpolation.tooltip: Resize filter. Lanczos is the default quality choice.

image.tooltip: Optional source image. If empty, the node creates a blank image at the selected size.

crop_x.tooltip: Saved horizontal crop position. Drag inside the Resize Box preview to change it.

crop_y.tooltip: Saved vertical crop position. Drag inside the Resize Box preview to change it.

crop_zoom.tooltip: Saved crop zoom. Drag any crop corner while keeping the output aspect ratio locked.

DenoResolutionSetup.name: DenoResolutionSetup
DenoResolutionSetup.description:
DENO Custom Nodes v0.7.87.
The DENO info button checks Comfy Registry and marks this node when an update is available.

Resolution helper and image resize node for ComfyUI.
Preset ratio, manual input, or keep-input-ratio auto mode with MP-based sizing, divisible-by alignment, aspect-locked crop positioning and zoom, fit resize, and realtime ratio preview.
YouTube: https://www.youtube.com/@Denoise-AI
output_tooltips: Resized image, or a blank image if no input image was connected.
Final output width in pixels.
Final output height in pixels.

image_paths.tooltip: Selected image file list managed by the node UI.

mode.tooltip: Choose how each image is resized before the batch output is built.

ratio_preset.tooltip: Target aspect ratio used in Preset Ratio mode.

megapixels.tooltip: Target total image size in megapixels for automatic sizing modes.

width.tooltip: Manual or fallback output width in pixels.

height.tooltip: Manual or fallback output height in pixels.

divisible_by.tooltip: Round the final batch size to a model-safe multiple.

interpolation.tooltip: Resize filter. Lanczos is the default quality choice.

resize_method.tooltip: Choose crop-fill or fit/letterbox behavior for loaded images.

DenoMultiImageLoader.name: DenoMultiImageLoader
DenoMultiImageLoader.description:
DENO Custom Nodes v0.7.87.
The DENO info button checks Comfy Registry and marks this node when an update is available.

Minor-upgrade multi image loader for ComfyUI with drag reorder, paste/upload support, and stable batch output.
YouTube: https://www.youtube.com/@Denoise-AI
output_tooltips: Loaded images resized into one same-size IMAGE batch.
Final batch width in pixels.
Final batch height in pixels.

image_paths.tooltip: Ordered MiniMax H3 reference-image list managed by the node UI.

DenoMiniMaxH3ReferenceImageLoader.name: DenoMiniMaxH3ReferenceImageLoader
DenoMiniMaxH3ReferenceImageLoader.display_name: (Deno) MiniMax H3 Multi Reference Image Loader
DenoMiniMaxH3ReferenceImageLoader.description:
DENO Custom Nodes v0.7.87.
The DENO info button checks Comfy Registry and marks this node when an update is available.

Load up to 9 ordered MiniMax H3 reference images through one cable. Each image keeps its own decoded size and aspect ratio; card order maps to <Picture 1>, <Picture 2>, and so on. The optional IMAGE list output can reuse the same ordered sources in nodes such as DENO Local LLM Loader.
output_tooltips: Ordered MiniMax H3 reference-image bundle with each image's decoded size and aspect ratio preserved.
The same ordered sources as a mixed-size IMAGE list for nodes such as DENO Local LLM Loader.

clip.tooltip: MiniMax H3 text/image encoder used to tokenize the prompt and references.

vae.tooltip: MiniMax H3 video VAE used to encode reference images and videos.

audio_vae.tooltip: MiniMax H3 audio VAE used to encode reference audio.

prompt.tooltip: Prompt for the generated video. Refer to loaded images as <Picture 1>, <Picture 2>, and so on.

width.tooltip: Generated video width in pixels.

height.tooltip: Generated video height in pixels.

ref_image_size.tooltip: Keep stock H3 reference sizing: match the generation area or use the larger max reference pipeline.

ref_images.tooltip: Ordered image bundle from the DENO MiniMax H3 Reference Image Loader.

ref_videos.tooltip: Stock MiniMax H3 reference-video slots, in prompt tag order.

ref_video_audios.tooltip: Stock MiniMax H3 soundtrack slots paired by number with reference videos.

ref_video_audio.tooltip: Soundtrack of the same-numbered reference video

ref_audios.tooltip: Stock MiniMax H3 standalone reference-audio slots, in prompt tag order.

output_tooltips: Positive MiniMax H3 conditioning containing the ordered image, video, and audio references.
Empty MiniMax H3 audio/video latent for sampling.
DenoMiniMaxH3ReferenceToVideo.name: DenoMiniMaxH3ReferenceToVideo
DenoMiniMaxH3ReferenceToVideo.description:
DENO Custom Nodes v0.7.87.
The DENO info button checks Comfy Registry and marks this node when an update is available.

Use one ordered DENO reference-image bundle plus the stock MiniMax H3 reference video and audio slots. Prompt tags remain <Picture i>, <Video k>, and <Audio j>.

audio.tooltip: Source mono or stereo audio to transcribe locally. The node downmixes it to mono and resamples it to 16 kHz for Whisper.

model.tooltip: Local Whisper model size. large-v3 prioritizes lyric and difficult-speech accuracy; large-v3-turbo is the faster default. The official checkpoint downloads on first use to ComfyUI/models/stt/whisper.

language.tooltip: Choose a known language or let Whisper detect it automatically.

model_after_run.tooltip: CUDA Smart Swap unloads ComfyUI models before transcription. Unload also releases Whisper afterward; Keep loaded is an advanced repeated-run option.

manual_transcript.tooltip: Optional exact lyrics or dialogue. When non-empty, this wording is authoritative while Whisper still runs to provide approximate segment timing.

DenoAudioTranscript.name: DenoAudioTranscript
DenoAudioTranscript.description:
DENO Custom Nodes v0.7.87.
The DENO info button checks Comfy Registry and marks this node when an update is available.

Transcribes one source audio clip locally with official Whisper, using CUDA Smart Swap and first-use model download, then returns structured context plus the effective transcript. Optional user-supplied lyrics or dialogue overrides Whisper wording while Whisper still supplies approximate segment timing.
output_tooltips: Structured transcript data with requested/detected language, timestamped segments, and a heuristic confidence band for an LLM prompt builder.
Effective plain transcript: the exact user-supplied lyrics or dialogue when provided, otherwise the Whisper transcript.
The original source AUDIO unchanged, for a guaranteed Whisper-before-Gemma Smart Swap chain.

analysis.tooltip: Raw Gemma 4 audio analysis from Text Generate. Reasoning chatter is removed and only the supported analysis fields are kept.

clip.tooltip: The same Gemma 4 CLIP value used by Text Generate. It lets the node release only that audio-analysis model after the text is ready.

model_after_run.tooltip: Unload releases only the connected audio-analysis CLIP model. Keep loaded is an advanced option for repeated runs.

DenoAudioAnalysisFinalize.name: DenoAudioAnalysisFinalize
DenoAudioAnalysisFinalize.description:
DENO Custom Nodes v0.7.87.
The DENO info button checks Comfy Registry and marks this node when an update is available.

Keeps only the structured audio-analysis fields needed by a beginner audio-reference workflow and can unload the analysis CLIP model after use.
output_tooltips: Canonical-order supported audio-analysis fields with Gemma reasoning and unrelated chatter removed.

image_paths.tooltip: Files, folders, absolute paths, or web URLs selected by the advanced source UI.

mode.tooltip: Choose how images are resized for the batch output.

ratio_preset.tooltip: Target aspect ratio used in Preset Ratio mode.

megapixels.tooltip: Target total image size in megapixels for automatic sizing modes.

width.tooltip: Manual or fallback output width in pixels.

height.tooltip: Manual or fallback output height in pixels.

divisible_by.tooltip: Round the final batch size to a model-safe multiple.

interpolation.tooltip: Resize filter. Lanczos is the default quality choice.

resize_method.tooltip: Choose crop-fill, fit, or advanced size handling for loaded images.

recursive_folders.tooltip: Include image files found inside subfolders.

list_output_mode.tooltip: Choose whether the image_list output keeps original sizes or matches the batch size.

disabled_image_paths.tooltip: Saved skipped sources. Managed by the UI when you disable items.

images.tooltip: Optional incoming images to merge with the selected file/path sources.

DenoAdvancedImageSourceLoader.name: DenoAdvancedImageSourceLoader
DenoAdvancedImageSourceLoader.description:
DENO Custom Nodes v0.7.87.
The DENO info button checks Comfy Registry and marks this node when an update is available.

Advanced image source loader for users who need external folders, absolute file paths, web URLs, batch output, and mixed-size image-list output.
Use the standard Multi Image Loader for simpler input-folder workflows.
YouTube: https://www.youtube.com/@Denoise-AI
output_tooltips: Loaded sources resized into one same-size IMAGE batch.
Loaded sources as an IMAGE list for workflows that accept different-sized images.
Final batch width in pixels.
Final batch height in pixels.
Number of images loaded from all active sources.

positive.tooltip: Base positive LTX conditioning before guide images are inserted.

negative.tooltip: Base negative LTX conditioning before guide images are inserted.

vae.tooltip: VAE used to encode the guide/reference images into the LTX latent space.

latent.tooltip: LTX latent timeline that receives the guide image keyframes.

DenoLTXSequencer.name: DenoLTXSequencer
DenoLTXSequencer.description:
DENO Custom Nodes v0.7.87.
The DENO info button checks Comfy Registry and marks this node when an update is available.

LTX sequencer with batch guide input and Deno sync-friendly widget layout.
Strength values can be synced or left independent in the frontend.
YouTube: https://www.youtube.com/@Denoise-AI

DenoLTX23PresetLoader.name: DenoLTX23PresetLoader
DenoLTX23PresetLoader.description:
DENO Custom Nodes v0.7.87.
The DENO info button checks Comfy Registry and marks this node when an update is available.

Unified LTX model loader for beginner workflows.
Choose Checkpoint Style, KJ Style, or GGUF Style and output MODEL/CLIP/video+audio VAE from one node.
Checkpoint Style uses the selected checkpoint as the CLIP projection file; text_projection is only for KJ/GGUF Style.
GGUF Style requires ComfyUI-GGUF. KJ/GGUF Style requires comfyui-kjnodes.
YouTube: https://www.youtube.com/@Denoise-AI
output_tooltips: Loaded LTX model.
Loaded text encoder / CLIP stack.
Video VAE for LTX video latents.
Audio VAE for LTX audio latents.

DenoLTXPromptGuide.name: DenoLTXPromptGuide
DenoLTXPromptGuide.description:
DENO Custom Nodes v0.7.87.
The DENO info button checks Comfy Registry and marks this node when an update is available.

Combines CLIP text encoding and LTXV frame-rate conditioning into one LTX prompt node.
The UI estimates quoted dialogue duration for planning only.
YouTube: https://www.youtube.com/@Denoise-AI

Encoded negative conditioning with LTX frame-rate metadata.

vae.tooltip: LTX VAE used for the latent channel statistics around the upscaler.

horizontal_tiles.tooltip: Frame width split count. 2 means left and right tiles.

vertical_tiles.tooltip: Frame height split count. 3 means top, middle, and bottom tiles.

overlap.tooltip: Overlap in input latent tokens. Larger values blend more context but use more time.

blend_mode.tooltip: Overlap weighting curve. Hann is the recommended starting point.

aggressive_memory_cleanup.tooltip: Run extra cleanup between tiles. This can be much slower, but may help fragmented VRAM or OOM cases.

debug.tooltip: Print tile plan and shape diagnostics to the ComfyUI console.

DenoLTXTiledSpatialUpscaler.name: DenoLTXTiledSpatialUpscaler
DenoLTXTiledSpatialUpscaler.description:
DENO Custom Nodes v0.7.87.
The DENO info button checks Comfy Registry and marks this node when an update is available.

Runs the LTX latent spatial upscaler on overlapping spatial tiles, then reconstructs one video latent with float32 blending. Use it before a large low-denoise second pass when tall LTX outputs start drifting in colour or conditioning.
output_tooltips: Upscaled video latent reconstructed from overlapping spatial tiles.

noise.tooltip: Noise source used once for the global AV sampler trajectory.

guider.tooltip: BasicGuider or CFGGuider for the LTX AV second pass, including LTX guide metadata from upstream Sequencer/Add Guide nodes.

sampler.tooltip: ComfyUI sampler object. The node keeps the sampler update global.

sigmas.tooltip: Sigma schedule for the low-denoise AV second-pass refinement.

latent_image.tooltip: LTX AV nested latent containing video and audio. If guides are present, run LTXVSeparateAVLatent after this sampler, then apply LTXVCropGuides to the video latent before decode.

horizontal_tiles.tooltip: Frame width split count. 2 means left and right tiles.

vertical_tiles.tooltip: Frame height split count. 3 means top, middle, and bottom tiles.

overlap.tooltip: Overlap in latent video tokens for each model-prediction tile, including guide-bearing video frames.

audio_mode.tooltip: Freeze keeps audio unchanged while still using it as context for video denoising.

blend_mode.tooltip: Overlap weighting curve. Hann is the recommended starting point.

aggressive_memory_cleanup.tooltip: Run extra cleanup between AV tile predictions. This can be much slower, but may help fragmented VRAM or OOM cases.

debug.tooltip: Print AV hook calls, sigma labels, and tile diagnostics to the ComfyUI console.

DenoLTXAVStepFusedTiledSampler.description:

DenoBerniniPromptGuide.name: DenoBerniniPromptGuide
DenoBerniniPromptGuide.description:
DENO Custom Nodes v0.7.87.
The DENO info button checks Comfy Registry and marks this node when an update is available.

KJ-style Bernini prompt helper for ComfyUI.

This node does not implement Bernini conditioning by itself. It only prepares the positive and negative text conditioning that you connect into KJ/ComfyUI's Bernini Conditioning workflow.

- Choose the System Prompt mode at the top. The node prepends the same short system prompt prefix shown in KJ's Bernini prompt table.
- Write prompts like you are instructing a chatbot: `Replace the jacket with the shirt from image0. Keep the camera motion, face, background, lighting, and shadows unchanged.`
- Reference modes automatically add a short image0/image1/image2 naming hint internally.
- Negative Preset fills the visible negative prompt box. Edit that box directly; the edited text is what gets encoded.

Bernini visual conditioning still requires a ComfyUI/KJ backend that supports Bernini context latents.

Encoded negative conditioning for the Bernini/KJ workflow.

DenoLocalLLMRefiner.name: DenoLocalLLMRefiner
DenoLocalLLMRefiner.description:
DENO Custom Nodes v0.7.87.
The DENO info button checks Comfy Registry and marks this node when an update is available.

Call a local Ollama, LM Studio, llama.cpp, vLLM, Custom, or llama-swap model from ComfyUI and help rewrite or review prompt text.

An optional IMAGE input can be attached to the local model call. Use a vision-capable local model for image review. An optional Video Seconds FLOAT input adds a short English duration sentence to each user prompt. Optional audio_context STRING data can carry upstream transcript and acoustic evidence without replacing the user prompt; only explicitly labeled user-supplied wording is authoritative.

When this node executes, its final Result is stored in the embedded workflow state so reopening a saved PNG or workflow restores it. Thinking and reasoning stay preview-only and are not persisted in that state.

Designed for prompt-batcher workflows: use the in-node Prompt field or connect STRING into Prompt, and this node processes the whole prompt batch in one execution so the local LLM can stay loaded until the batch is complete.

Only localhost / 127.0.0.1 servers are allowed by default. Advanced users can allow a specific LAN LLM server with DENO_LOCAL_LLM_ALLOWED_HOSTS=LAN-IP:port on the ComfyUI host; this opt-in is not stored in workflows.

DENO Custom Nodes v0.7.87.
The DENO info button checks Comfy Registry and marks this node when an update is available.

RTX VFX install steps for beginners.

1. Close every ComfyUI window first.
2. Click this node's `How to install` button.
3. Follow the visual web install guide.
4. Download the ZIP from that guide page.
5. Open `ComfyUI\custom_nodes\deno-custom-nodes\tools`.
6. Move `install_rtx_vfx_bat.zip` into that `tools` folder.
7. Right-click the ZIP inside `tools`, choose `Extract All`, then open the extracted installer files.
8. Double-click `install_rtx_vfx.bat` from inside `tools`.
9. If it asks `Install RTX VFX here?`, type `Y` only when the shown Windows path is inside this ComfyUI app. If it looks wrong, type `N` and stop.
10. Wait until the BAT shows the green `INSTALL COMPLETE` message.
11. Start ComfyUI again, then run this node.

Full install guide:
https://deno2026.github.io/comfyui-deno-custom-nodes/rtx-vfx-install/

MiniMaxDirectorCast.name: MiniMaxDirectorCast
MiniMaxDirectorCast.description:
Everyone in the clip, one card each: their face, what stays the same, how they sound.

A character is four things -- a face, a name, a description the model must honour, and
a voice -- and they used to be authored in two different parts of the director with
nothing on screen tying them together. They are written here instead and folded into
the timeline at compile time.

Wire `cast` into the director. The card names the file it draws a person out of by
filename rather than by `<Picture n>`: the ordinal is computed from where blocks sit
on the timeline and changes when one is dragged, and a card that quietly re-pointed at
a different photograph is a mistake you would only see in the finished video.

MiniMaxDirectorPrompt.name: MiniMaxDirectorPrompt
MiniMaxDirectorPrompt.description:
Show the compiled prompt, updating as the timeline is edited.

`PreviewAny` would display the same string, but only after a run: it fills from
execution results, so while you are writing the timeline the box sits empty -- which
is exactly when you want to read what the model is being told.

This node exists so the editor has somewhere to put its own answer. Wire the
director's `prompt` output to `source` and the web extension paints it here on every
edit pause, compiled by the same code the graph would run. Executing the graph fills
it the ordinary way, so the node is honest with the extension missing.

megapixels.tooltip: Target area using ComfyUI's 1024*1024 megapixel unit. / 使用 ComfyUI 的 1024*1024 百万像素单位设置目标面积。

seconds.tooltip: Duration at 24 fps, snapped up to H3's 17k+5 frame grid. / 按 24 fps 设置时长，并向上对齐到 H3 的 17k+5 帧网格。

steps.tooltip: Used only when a hardware cost profile is selected. / 仅在选择硬件成本配置时使用。

vram_budget_gib.tooltip: Compared only with thresholds from the selected profile. / 仅与所选配置中的阈值比较。

clamp_to_trained_cap.tooltip: Off reports the canvas ComfyUI will actually create. On shrinks over-cap requests to H3's documented trained area. / 关闭时报告 ComfyUI 实际创建的画布；开启时将超限请求缩小到 H3 文档中的训练面积。

MiniMaxH3XSplitAV.description: Split an H3 AV latent into separate video and audio latents. / 将 H3 音视频潜空间拆分为独立的视频和音频潜空间。

strict.tooltip: Reject streams whose latent_t and audio_t disagree, or whose latent_t is off the 17k+5 grid. Turn off only when deliberately building an irregular pair. / 拒绝时长不一致或不符合 17k+5 网格的流；仅在有意构建非标准组合时关闭。

MiniMaxH3XJoinAV.name: MiniMaxH3XJoinAV

MiniMaxH3XJoinAV.description: Recombine video and audio latents into an H3 AV latent. Validates that both streams describe the same frame count. / 将视频和音频潜空间重新合并为 H3 音视频潜空间，并验证两个流对应相同帧数。

MiniMaxH3XLatentInfo.name: MiniMaxH3XLatentInfo

width.tooltip: Target pixel width; divided by 16 for the latent grid. / 目标像素宽度；潜空间网格宽度为该值除以 16。

MiniMaxH3XUpscaleVideoLatent.name: MiniMaxH3XUpscaleVideoLatent
MiniMaxH3XUpscaleVideoLatent.display_name: MiniMax H3 Upscale Video Latent / 放大视频潜空间
MiniMaxH3XUpscaleVideoLatent.description: Resize the video stream of an H3 AV latent, leaving audio alone. Target pixel dimensions snap to multiples of 32. / 仅调整 H3 音视频潜空间中的视频尺寸，音频保持不变；目标像素尺寸对齐到 32 的倍数。

keep_seconds.tooltip: Duration to keep from the start, aligned to the frame grid. / 从开头保留的时长，并对齐到帧网格。

MiniMaxH3XTemporalTrim.name: MiniMaxH3XTemporalTrim
MiniMaxH3XTemporalTrim.display_name: MiniMax H3 Temporal Trim / 时长裁剪
MiniMaxH3XTemporalTrim.description: Shorten an H3 AV latent, keeping video and audio coherent. The result is snapped to the model's 17k+5 frame grid. / 在保持音视频同步的同时缩短 H3 潜空间，并将结果对齐到模型的 17k+5 帧网格。

mode.tooltip: t2va/fl2va expect the three base fields; ref2va expects the six full-reference fields. / t2va/fl2va 需要三个基础字段；ref2va 需要六个完整参考字段。

duration_seconds.tooltip: Clip duration, used to flag cut times past the end. 0 disables that check. / 片段时长，用于标记超出结尾的切镜时间；0 表示禁用此检查。

ref_images.tooltip: How many reference images are connected, so <Picture N> beyond that can be flagged. / 已连接的参考图片数量，用于标记超出范围的 <Picture N>。

raise_on_warning.tooltip: Fail the workflow instead of passing the prompt through. Off by default so a lint warning never blocks a render. / 发现警告时让工作流失败，而不是继续传递提示词；默认关闭，避免检查警告阻止渲染。

MiniMaxH3XPromptLint.name: MiniMaxH3XPromptLint
MiniMaxH3XPromptLint.display_name: MiniMax H3 Prompt Lint / 提示词检查
MiniMaxH3XPromptLint.description: Check an H3 prompt against MiniMax's documented format rules. Deterministic -- no LLM, no rewriting. Passes the prompt through unchanged so it can sit inline in a workflow. / 按 MiniMax 文档规则检查 H3 提示词；不使用 LLM、不改写，并原样传递提示词。

conditioning.tooltip: Conditioning from an H3 conditioning node, with the soundscape/music text changed. / 来自 H3 条件节点的条件，其中环境音或音乐文字已经修改。

av_latent.tooltip: The AV latent from the run whose picture you want to keep. / 需要保留画面的原始运行所产生的音视频潜空间。

video_cond_strength.tooltip: Noise augmentation on the video reference. 1.0 feeds it perfectly clean for maximum preservation; lower values let the picture drift. The DiT keyframe default is 0.999. / 视频参考的噪声增强值。1.0 表示完全干净并最大程度保留画面；较低值会允许画面变化。DiT 的关键帧默认值为 0.999。

reset_audio_latent.tooltip: Start the audio stream from zeros so the sampler writes a genuinely new track. Off reuses the old audio latent and biases the result toward the original. / 从零开始音频流，让采样器生成全新音轨；关闭时复用旧音频潜空间，结果会偏向原音轨。

MiniMaxH3XAudioReroll.name: MiniMaxH3XAudioReroll
MiniMaxH3XAudioReroll.display_name: MiniMax H3 Audio Reroll (Experimental) / 音频重生成（实验性）
MiniMaxH3XAudioReroll.description: Experimental: condition a fresh H3 sampling run on an already-generated video latent, so a new soundtrack can be produced without re-authoring the picture. The video is strongly preserved but resampled, not frozen -- use video_passthrough downstream for a bit-identical mux. / 以已生成的视频潜空间作为参考重新采样音频；画面会被强力保留但仍会重采样。如需逐位一致的画面，请在下游使用 video_passthrough 混流。

MiniMaxH3XNF4VideoVAELoader.description: Load the DiffSynth-format MiniMax H3 NF4 video VAE. / 加载 DiffSynth 格式的 MiniMax H3 NF4 视频 VAE。

MiniMaxH3XNF4AudioVAELoader.description: Load the DiffSynth-format MiniMax H3 NF4 audio VAE. / 加载 DiffSynth 格式的 MiniMax H3 NF4 音频 VAE。

start_frame.tooltip: Start of the render window, in timeline frames.

end_frame.tooltip: End of the render window, in timeline frames.

segment_lengths.tooltip: Auto-populated from the timeline editor (pixel-space frame counts).

guide_strength.tooltip: Auto-populated from the timeline editor. H3 has no per-keyframe strength, so it is ignored.

model.tooltip: The fl2va weights (minimax_h3_fl2va_*), used when the toolbar is on 'Refs OFF'. Connect both models and the node loads whichever the toolbar switch calls for — the other one is never read from disk.

model_ref2va.tooltip: The ref2va weights (minimax_h3_ref2va_*), used when the toolbar is on 'Refs ON'. Optional — with only one model connected that one is used either way.

audio_vae.tooltip: minimax_h3_audio_vae. Only needed when audio references are used (ref2va).

global_prompt.tooltip: Conditions the whole video: style, scene, characters. Written above the storyboard.

use_custom_audio.tooltip: ON: timeline audio clips are used as <Audio j> references (ref2va). The mixdown is always available on combined_audio regardless.

use_custom_motion.tooltip: ON: the reference-video track feeds <Video k> references (ref2va).

inpaint_audio.tooltip: Unused on H3 — audio is generated jointly with the video and cannot be inpainted.

frame_rate.tooltip: Timeline editing rate. Output is always 24 fps; times are converted via seconds.

display_mode.tooltip: Show the ruler and segment ranges in frames or seconds.

custom_width.tooltip: Output width. With height set too this is a BOX: 'maintain aspect ratio' keeps the first image's aspect inside it. 0 = derive from the image.

resize_method.tooltip: How timeline images are fitted to the output canvas.

divisible_by.tooltip: Snap output dimensions to this multiple. H3 needs 32.

img_compression.tooltip: H.264 CRF baked into each keyframe. 0 = off (recommended for H3).

override_audio.tooltip: Use the reference video's own soundtrack as the timeline audio.

ref_image_size.tooltip: ref2va only. 'match' scales references to the output pixel area (fast); 'max' keeps a 2048 px short edge for identity, at real speed cost.

ref_images.tooltip: Extra <Picture i> references (single image or batch), appended after the character slots. ref2va only.

ref_image_notes.tooltip: One line per image on 'ref_images', describing what it is: 'the kitchen set', 'a storyboard reference for the opening'. Without a line the picture is still numbered but the prompt says nothing about it. Blank lines count, so line 3 always belongs to the third image.

duration.tooltip: Automation (connection-only). Render length in SECONDS.

MiniMaxH3DirectorCS.name: MiniMaxH3DirectorCS
MiniMaxH3DirectorCS.description: Visual timeline for MiniMax H3. Segments become a storyboard prompt with [0s-1.5s] shot markers, timeline images become first/last keyframes (fl2va) or <Picture i> references (ref2va), the reference-video track becomes <Video k>, and audio clips become <Audio j> plus a muxable audio output. Retake Mode regenerates a marked range of a base video between its own surrounding frames.

model.tooltip: Model to attach the preview to.

decode.tooltip: latent2rgb is a single matmul — effectively free, rough colours. vae is the real decoder: true colours, but it costs real time per preview, so raise every_n_steps with it.

preview_target.tooltip: Where the preview appears: on this node, in the sampler's usual preview slot (needs VideoHelperSuite), or both.

max_resolution.tooltip: Long edge of the preview image. With latent2rgb the source is latent-sized (a 1344x768 shot is an 84x48 grid), so this upscales — smooth, but soft. Use decode='vae (quality)' when you need to judge detail.

preview_frames.tooltip: How many frames of the shot to show. Frames are thinned evenly, so this caps the cost without cropping the timeline.

preview_fps.tooltip: The shot's own frame rate — 24 for H3. FLOAT so the Director's 'fps' output can be wired straight in. Whether the preview actually plays at this rate depends on 'playback'; with 'true speed' it is a ceiling, not a promise.

vae.tooltip: minimax_h3_video_vae. Only needed for decode='vae (quality)'.

webp_quality.tooltip: WebP quality of the animation sent to the node.

every_n_steps.tooltip: Never preview more often than every N sampler steps.

max_preview_overhead.tooltip: Cap on how much of the render time previews may use, in percent. A full VAE decode can cost tens of seconds per preview; this spaces them out automatically instead of stalling the run. 0 disables the cap.

suppress_default_preview.tooltip: Hide ComfyUI's built-in single-frame preview while this runs.

playback.tooltip: 'true speed' spreads the sampled frames across the shot's real duration, so the preview lasts exactly as long as the finished clip — but with latent2rgb that caps at preview_fps / 3.35, because there is one image per latent frame and H3 compresses time by that much. 'source fps' plays them at preview_fps flat, like ComfyUI's own preview: motion reads at normal speed, the clip ends early. Judge timing with the first, movement with the second.

output_tooltips: Model with the preview attached.
MiniMaxH3PreviewOverrideCS.name: MiniMaxH3PreviewOverrideCS
MiniMaxH3PreviewOverrideCS.description: Live preview of the whole shot while it denoises, shown on this node. Core previews only ever draw the first latent frame; MiniMax H3's packed audio+video latent also has to be unpacked first, which the LTX preview nodes do not do. Wire between the Director's model output and the sampler.

images.tooltip: The decoded retake (VAEDecode output).

audio.tooltip: The retake's audio (VAEDecodeAudio output). Left out, the base video's own audio is kept throughout.

keep_base_audio.tooltip: Ignore the generated audio and keep the base video's soundtrack across the whole result.

output_tooltips: Full-length video frames at 24 fps.
MiniMaxH3RetakeStitchCS.name: MiniMaxH3RetakeStitchCS
MiniMaxH3RetakeStitchCS.description: Splices a Retake Mode result back into its base video: base head + the generated range + base tail, video and audio, all on H3's 24 fps grid. Wire the Director's retake_info in; it carries the range that was rendered.

idea.tooltip: What you want, in plain words. The vision model turns this plus the images into a MiniMax-shaped prompt.

preset.tooltip: 'global' writes scene, style, subjects and lighting and leaves the shots to your timeline. 'storyboard' writes the whole shot sequence with timestamps — use it only when your timeline segments carry no prompt text, or the two shot numberings will collide.

images.tooltip: Up to 9 reference images. They are described by the vision model and passed straight through to ref_images.

image.tooltip: A reference image. A new socket appears as you connect; disconnecting closes the gap.

system_prompt.tooltip: Overrides the built-in instructions. Leave empty to use the preset's own, which is derived from MiniMax's prompt-writing guide.

duration_seconds.tooltip: Told to the model so its timestamps fit. Match the Director's duration.

base_url.tooltip: Empty = the provider's default (Ollama http://127.0.0.1:11434, LM Studio http://127.0.0.1:1234). http:// is added if you leave it off. No path — just host and port.

model.tooltip: Model name. Must be a VISION model — a text-only model will ignore your images without saying so. Empty falls back to the provider default.

seed.tooltip: ComfyUI caches node outputs, so an unchanged input means the model is never asked again. Change this to force a fresh answer.

max_image_size.tooltip: Long edge the images are downscaled to before they are sent. Larger costs time and buys little.

max_words.tooltip: Hard limit on the description. MiniMax's guide puts a detailed_description at 350-500 words; small models ignore that when asked politely, so the request is capped and the result trimmed to a sentence end. 0 disables both.

unload_after.tooltip: Drop the vision model from VRAM when done, so it is not still resident while H3 samples. Turn off only while iterating on prompts — reloading costs seconds, an OOM costs the render. Works with Ollama, and with llama-server in router mode. A plain llama-server or LM Studio cannot be told to let go over HTTP — give those an idle timeout of their own (llama.cpp: --sleep-idle-seconds N).

on_error.tooltip: 'passthrough' hands your raw idea on and warns, so a stopped Ollama does not kill the whole run.

output_tooltips: Wire into the Director's global_prompt.
The same images, batched. Wire into the Director's ref_images.
The duration you set above, passed on so you only type it once. Wire into the Director's `duration` input (the connection-only one, in seconds).
MiniMaxH3EnhancePromptCS.name: MiniMaxH3EnhancePromptCS
MiniMaxH3EnhancePromptCS.description: Turns a one-line idea plus reference images into a MiniMax-H3 prompt, using a local vision model (Ollama / LM Studio / OpenAI-compatible). Wire `prompt` into the Director's global_prompt and `ref_images` into its ref_images, so the model describes exactly the images H3 conditions on.

prompt.tooltip: Wire this from your director-style node's compiled_prompt output — the refine pass reuses the exact prompt the candidate was generated from.

candidate.tooltip: Which of the four candidate slots to refine. Set by the button selector in the node's UI. Defaults to 0 (none picked yet) — the node deliberately refuses to run at 0, rather than silently falling back to candidate 1, so a graph can't get queued before you've actually chosen one.

megapixels.tooltip: Target resolution for the refined output — normally higher than whatever resolution the candidates were scouted at.

resize_method.tooltip: How the selected candidate's frames get fit to the new target resolution when its aspect ratio doesn't match.

ref_image_size.tooltip: Only used when ref_images is connected. 'match' scales references down to the output's pixel area (faster). 'max' keeps up to a 2048px short edge for stronger identity fidelity, but reference tokens ride every sampling step so it's several times slower.

denoise.tooltip: How much of the candidate's own content survives vs. gets redrawn. Low values (~0.2-0.3) stay close to the candidate and mostly add resolution/detail. High values (~0.6+) let the model redraw more, which can drift from the candidate's content — 1.0 regenerates from scratch and ignores it entirely.

ref_images.tooltip: The same character/product reference photos that anchored identity and fine detail (exact prop shape, skin, likeness) in the original candidate — e.g. wired from MuseMinimaxDirector's ref_images_used output. Without this, the refine pass only has the text prompt to go on, and any detail the prompt doesn't spell out explicitly is free to drift during the partial-denoise redraw — this is what locks it back down.

resize_type.tooltip: Choose to scale by a multiplier or to exact target dimensions.

width.tooltip: Target width in pixels.

height.tooltip: Target height in pixels.

ConditioningZeroAndTruncate.name: ConditioningZeroAndTruncate
ConditioningZeroAndTruncate.description: Use for negative conditioning with SD3.5. ConditioningZeroOut does not truncate the embedding,                     which results in severe degradation of image quality with SD3.5 when the token limit is exceeded.

ConditioningTruncate.name: ConditioningTruncate
ConditioningTruncate.description: Use for positive conditioning with SD3.5. Tokens beyond 77 result in degradation of image quality.

SigmasPreview.name: SigmasPreview
SigmasPreview.description: Saves the input images to your ComfyUI output directory.

noise_mode.tooltip: How noise scales with the sigma schedule. Hard is the most aggressive, the others start strong and drop rapidly.

plot_max.tooltip: Set to a negative value to have the plot scale automatically.

plot_min.tooltip: Set to a negative value to have the plot scale automatically.

SigmasSchedulePreview.name: SigmasSchedulePreview
SigmasSchedulePreview.description: Saves the input images to your ComfyUI output directory.

skip_self_attn_blocks.tooltip: For WAN only: select self-attn blocks to disable. Due to the size of the self-attn masks, VRAM required to compile blocks using regional WAN is excessive. List any blocks selected in the ReWanPatcher node.

sliding_window_frames.tooltip: How many real frames each frame sees. Divide frames by 4 to get real frames.

UNetSave.name: UNetSave
UNetSave.description: Save a .safetensors containing only the model data.

Sigmas Noise Inversion.name: Sigmas Noise Inversion
Sigmas Noise Inversion.description: For use with unsampling. Connect sigmas_fwd to the unsampling (first) node, and sigmas_rev to the sampling (second) node.

Sigmas Variance Floor.name: Sigmas Variance Floor
Sigmas Variance Floor.description: Process a sigma schedule so that any steps that are too large for variance-locked SDE sampling are replaced with the maximum permissible value.Will be very difficult to approach sigma = 0 due to the nature of the math, as steps become very small much below approximately sigma = 0.15 to 0.2.

bias_split_up.tooltip: If True, split happens above the split value, so high_sigmas includes the split point.

Sigmas Split Value.name: Sigmas Split Value
Sigmas Split Value.description: Splits sigma schedule at a specific sigma value.

width.tooltip: The width of the desired resize. A pixel value if measurement is 'pixels' or a 100% scale percentage value if measurement is 'percentage'. Passing '0' will calculate the dimension based on the height.

fit.tooltip:
'crop' resizes so the image covers the desired width and height, and center-crops the excess, returning exactly the desired width and height.
'pad' resizes so the image fits inside the desired width and height, and fills the empty space returning exactly the desired width and height.
'contain' resizes so the image fits inside the desired width and height, and returns the image with it's new size, with one side liekly smaller than the desired.

Note, if either width or height is '0', the effective fit is 'contain'.

SineForgeKrea2CharacterIngredientsPlanne.name: SineForgeKrea2CharacterIngredientsPlanner
SineForgeKrea2CharacterIngredientsPlanne.display_name: SineForge · Selectable Local Model · Krea 2 Character Ingredients JSON
SineForgeKrea2CharacterIngredientsPlanne.description: Uses a selectable, locally installed LM Studio GGUF package to turn one strict character-profile JSON object and one identity image into four Krea 2 prompts for a clean Ingredients identity set. The dropdown is bounded to the approved local model root; the existing Qwen 3.6 40B is preferred by default. Every prompt source and provenance hash is saved in prompt_json. ComfyUI models are released before planning, and all LM Studio models are unloaded before the image prompts are returned.

SineForgeLTXKreaContinuationPlanner.name: SineForgeLTXKreaContinuationPlanner
SineForgeLTXKreaContinuationPlanner.display_name: SineForge · Local Model Krea 2 Continuation JSON
SineForgeLTXKreaContinuationPlanner.description: Uses a selectable local LM Studio GGUF package to plan one general Krea 2 still-image continuation and its LTX-2.3 animation. The source may be people, objects, places, products, environments, or styles. Qwen 3.6 40B is the default, not the only choice. ComfyUI models are released first, every LM Studio model is unloaded before outputs are returned, and all prompts are embedded in prompt_json.

SineForgeLTXPodcastPlanner.name: SineForgeLTXPodcastPlanner
SineForgeLTXPodcastPlanner.description: Uses a selectable LM Studio GGUF installed under the approved local model root to create a fresh strict-JSON two-person podcast variation. Qwen 3.6 40B is only the default. Text-only models remain selectable and receive JSON without an image attachment. The node releases ComfyUI models first and refuses to return until every LM Studio model is unloaded, preventing local-LLM/LTX VRAM overlap. No hosted model, remote endpoint, or API key is accepted.

language.tooltip: ChatterBox language model to use for text-to-speech generation. Local models are preferred over remote downloads.

device.tooltip:
Device to run ChatterBox model on:
• auto: Automatically select best available (MPS on Apple Silicon, CUDA on NVIDIA, XPU on Intel, CPU fallback)
• cuda: NVIDIA GPU (requires CUDA-capable GPU)
• xpu: Intel GPU (requires Intel PyTorch XPU)
• cpu: CPU-only processing (slower)
• mps: Apple Metal Performance Shaders (Apple Silicon Macs only)

exaggeration.tooltip: Speech exaggeration level for ChatterBox. Higher values create more dramatic and expressive speech.

temperature.tooltip: Controls randomness in ChatterBox generation. Higher values = more creative/varied speech, lower values = more consistent speech.

cfg_weight.tooltip: Classifier-Free Guidance weight for ChatterBox. Controls how strongly the model follows the text prompt.

crash_protection_template.tooltip: Custom padding template for short text segments to prevent ChatterBox crashes. ChatterBox has a bug where text shorter than ~21 characters causes CUDA tensor errors. Use {seg} as placeholder for the original text. Examples: '...ummmmm {seg}' (default hesitation), '{seg}... yes... {seg}' (repetition), 'Well, {seg}' (natural prefix), or empty string to disable padding.

language.tooltip: F5-TTS model variant to use. F5TTS_Base is the standard model, F5TTS_v1_Base is improved version, E2TTS_Base is enhanced variant. Note: This was previously called 'model' in individual nodes.

device.tooltip:
Device to run F5-TTS model on:
• auto: Automatically select best available (MPS on Apple Silicon, CUDA on NVIDIA, XPU on Intel, CPU fallback)
• cuda: NVIDIA GPU (requires CUDA-capable GPU)
• xpu: Intel GPU (requires Intel PyTorch XPU)
• cpu: CPU-only processing (slower)
• mps: Apple Metal Performance Shaders (Apple Silicon Macs only)

temperature.tooltip: Controls randomness in F5-TTS generation. Higher values = more creative/varied speech, lower values = more consistent/predictable speech.

speed.tooltip: F5-TTS native speech speed control. 1.0 = normal speed, 0.5 = half speed (slower), 2.0 = double speed (faster).

target_rms.tooltip: Target audio volume level (Root Mean Square). Controls output loudness normalization. Higher values = louder audio output.

cross_fade_duration.tooltip: Duration in seconds for smooth audio transitions between F5-TTS segments. Prevents audio clicks/pops by blending segment boundaries.

nfe_step.tooltip: Neural Function Evaluation steps for F5-TTS inference. Higher values = better quality but slower generation. 32 is a good balance. Values above 71 may cause ODE solver issues.

cfg_strength.tooltip: Speech generation control. Lower values (1.0-1.5) = more natural, conversational delivery. Higher values (3.0-5.0) = crisper, more articulated speech with stronger emphasis. Default 2.0 balances naturalness and clarity.

model.tooltip:
Higgs Audio 2 model selection:
• higgs-audio-v2-3B: Main 3B parameter model with best quality and voice cloning capabilities
• Future models will appear here when available

The model handles voice cloning, multi-speaker generation, and natural speech synthesis.

device.tooltip:
Computation device selection:
• auto: Automatically select best available (MPS on Apple Silicon, CUDA on NVIDIA, XPU on Intel, CPU fallback)
• cuda: Force GPU acceleration (requires NVIDIA GPU with CUDA)
• xpu: Intel GPU acceleration (requires Intel PyTorch XPU)
• cpu: Force CPU-only processing (slower but works on any hardware)
• mps: Apple Metal Performance Shaders (Apple Silicon Macs only)

Recommended: Leave on 'auto' unless you have specific hardware requirements.

multi_speaker_mode.tooltip:
IMPORTANT: Each mode requires different text formats!

• Custom Character Switching: ⭐ MAIN METHOD - Use ANY character names like [Alice], [Bob], [Narrator]. Each segment generated separately with character-specific voice files from voices folder. Supports [pause:2] tags. Most flexible and reliable.

• Native Multi-Speaker (Conversation): Higgs Audio 2's native mode. MUST use [SPEAKER0] and [SPEAKER1] tags only! Requires opt_second_narrator input. NO pause tag support.

• Native Multi-Speaker (System Context): ⚠️ EXPERIMENTAL - Higgs Audio 2's native mode. MUST use [SPEAKER0] and [SPEAKER1] tags only! May produce audio artifacts. NO pause tag support.

system_prompt.tooltip:
System instruction that guides how Higgs Audio 2 generates speech:

• Default: 'Generate audio following instruction.' - Works for most cases
• Custom examples:
  - 'Speak clearly and slowly.' - For clearer pronunciation
  - 'Generate dramatic, emotional speech.' - For expressive delivery
  - 'Speak in a calm, professional tone.' - For business/formal content

This is an advanced parameter - the default usually works best unless you need specific speech characteristics.

temperature.tooltip:
🌡️ Controls speech creativity and randomness:

• 0.0-0.5: Very predictable, robotic speech (not recommended)
• 0.6-0.8: 🎯 RECOMMENDED - Conservative, natural speech with excellent consistency
• 1.0: Balanced natural variation but less consistent
• 1.2-1.5: More expressive, varied pronunciation and pacing
• 1.8-2.0: Highly creative but potentially unstable

0.8 provides the best balance of natural speech and consistency.

top_p.tooltip:
🎯 Nucleus sampling - controls vocabulary diversity:

• 0.1-0.3: Very limited vocabulary, may sound repetitive
• 0.5-0.7: 🎯 RECOMMENDED - Focused vocabulary for consistent, clear pronunciation
• 0.8-0.9: More varied speech patterns but less consistent
• 0.95-1.0: Maximum vocabulary diversity, may include rare pronunciations

0.6 provides excellent consistency while maintaining natural speech variation.

top_k.tooltip:
🔢 Limits vocabulary choices per word:

• -1: Disabled (uses only top_p)
• 10-30: Very focused, consistent pronunciation
• 40-60: Balanced consistency and variation
• 70-90: 🎯 RECOMMENDED - Broader vocabulary pool for natural speech
• 95-100: Maximum vocabulary freedom, more diverse but potentially inconsistent

Works with top_p (0.6) to provide good vocabulary range while maintaining consistency.

max_new_tokens.tooltip:
🔤 Maximum token limit - safety cap on generation length:

⚠️ This is a LIMIT, not a target. Model stops when audio is complete OR limit is reached.

• <10 tokens: ⚠️ May cause errors or cut off mid-word
• 200-500: Safe for short sentences, faster processing
• 1000-2048: 🎯 RECOMMENDED - Handles most content safely
• 3000-4096: For very long paragraphs only

For normal text like 'Hello Bob', 200 vs 2048 makes no difference - same quality and length. Only matters for very short limits (causes truncation) or very long text (needs higher limits).

force_audio_gen.tooltip:
🎵 Force Audio Generation:

• False: 🎯 RECOMMENDED - Model naturally chooses to generate audio tokens
• True: Force model to generate audio tokens rather than text tokens

⚠️ Only enable if model is generating text instead of audio. Usually not needed as the model should naturally generate audio for TTS requests.

ras_win_len.tooltip:
🪟 RAS Window Length - Repetition Avoidance Sampling window size:

• 0: Disable RAS completely (may cause repetitive speech)
• 3-5: Very strict repetition control (may sound unnatural)
• 7: 🎯 RECOMMENDED - Good balance of natural speech and repetition control
• 10-15: Looser repetition control, more natural but may repeat
• 20: Very loose control, natural speech but potential repetition

RAS prevents the model from repeating the same audio patterns within a sliding window.

ras_max_num_repeat.tooltip:
🔄 RAS Max Repetitions - Maximum allowed repetitions within RAS window:

• 1: No repetitions allowed (very strict, may sound choppy)
• 2: 🎯 RECOMMENDED - Allow minimal repetition for natural speech flow
• 3: Allow moderate repetition (more natural but some repetition)
• 4-5: Allow significant repetition (natural speech but potential repetitive patterns)

Works with RAS Window Length to control speech repetition patterns.

opt_second_narrator.tooltip: Second narrator voice for native multi-speaker modes. Used as SPEAKER1 voice when multi_speaker_mode is set to Native Multi-Speaker. Only needed for native modes, ignored in Custom Character Switching mode. First narrator (from Character Voices or TTS Text) becomes SPEAKER0.\n\n💡 TIP: Reference text significantly improves Higgs Audio voice cloning quality - always provide reference text with voice files.

enable_cuda_graphs.tooltip:
⚡ CUDA Graph Optimization:

• True (High Performance): 55+ tokens/sec generation speed with safe VRAM unloading. CUDA graphs auto-recreate on next generation. Recommended for best performance.

• False (Memory Safe): ~12 tokens/sec generation speed (78% slower), but uses no CUDA graphs. Use if you encounter any issues or need to minimize memory fragmentation.

✅ Both modes now support safe 'Unload Models' - CUDA graphs are automatically managed.

runtime_mode.tooltip:
IMPORTANT: Higgs Audio 2 is not stable enough on the main Transformers 5 environment right now.

Runtime Isolation:
• Main Environment: Use the main ComfyUI Python environment
• Shared Runtime: Use the existing shared legacy Transformers 4 runtime already used by VibeVoice/Qwen

Why this matters:
• The main ComfyUI env is on Transformers 5
• Higgs Audio 2 previously worked on the old T4 stack
• Shared runtime reuses that older stack without downgrading the whole app

⚠️ First run may create or refresh the shared secondary runtime and take a while.

HiggsAudioEngineNode.name: HiggsAudioEngineNode
HiggsAudioEngineNode.description: Configure Higgs Audio 2 engine for TTS generation with voice cloning. TIP: Reference text significantly improves voice cloning quality.

model.tooltip: Higgs Audio v3 TTS 4B official Boson model. Downloads to ComfyUI/models/TTS/higgs_audio_v3/. License: research and non-commercial use only.

device.tooltip: Device for native Higgs Audio v3 inference. CUDA is strongly recommended; CPU is very slow.

dtype.tooltip: auto uses bf16 on supported CUDA and fp32 otherwise. Use fp32 if bf16 produces unstable audio.

attention.tooltip: Attention backend. auto/sdpa is safest. flash_attention and sageattention require optional packages.

temperature.tooltip: Native sampling temperature. 0 is greedy; 0.8-1.1 is usually natural.

top_p.tooltip: Native nucleus sampling cutoff. 1.0 disables top-p filtering.

top_k.tooltip: Native top-k codebook sampling. 0 disables top-k filtering.

max_new_tokens.tooltip: Maximum generated audio-token steps per call. Raise if speech cuts off; prefer chunking for long text.

HiggsAudioV3EngineNode.name: HiggsAudioV3EngineNode
HiggsAudioV3EngineNode.description: Configure Higgs Audio v3 TTS. Type official inline tags directly in text, e.g. <|emotion:amusement|>, <|style:whispering|>, <|sfx:laughter|>Haha.

model_path.tooltip:
Step Audio EditX model selection:
• local:ModelName: Use locally installed model (respects extra_model_paths.yaml)
• ModelName: Auto-download model if not found locally
• Downloads respect extra_model_paths.yaml configuration

device.tooltip:
Device to run Step Audio EditX on:
• auto: Select the best available device
• cuda: NVIDIA GPU; this is a heavy model and 12GB+ VRAM is recommended
• cpu: Extremely slow and intended only as a fallback

torch_dtype.tooltip:
Model precision:
• bfloat16: Recommended on supported NVIDIA GPUs
• float16: Compatibility alternative with similar memory use
• float32: Much higher memory use; generally not recommended
• auto: Selects bfloat16 when supported, otherwise float16

quantization.tooltip:
LLM weight quantization:
• none: Best quality and compatibility
• int8: Reduces LLM weight memory
• int4: Stronger reduction with a larger quality/compatibility tradeoff
The audio tokenizer and vocoder are not quantized, so total VRAM does not shrink proportionally.

temperature.tooltip:
Sampling temperature for generation.
• Lower (0.3-0.5): More consistent, predictable output
• Default (0.7): Balanced creativity and stability
• Higher (1.0+): More varied, potentially unstable

do_sample.tooltip:
Enable sampling for generation.
• True: Uses temperature for varied output (recommended)
• False: Greedy decoding can fail to emit an end token and is not recommended

max_new_tokens.tooltip:
Maximum generated audio tokens (safety ceiling):
• 512: roughly 12s
• 1024: roughly 25s (recommended)
• Higher values allow longer output but increase runtime and KV-cache memory.

runtime_mode.tooltip:
Python runtime used by Step Audio EditX:
• Shared Runtime: Recommended. Uses the shared Transformers 4 runtime and was verified with Step EditX.
• Dedicated Runtime: Uses a separate Step EditX Transformers 4 environment. Choose this only to isolate dependency conflicts.
• Main Environment: Uses ComfyUI's packages. Transformers 5 currently produces invalid Step audio tokens and is not recommended.

model.tooltip:
VibeVoice model selection:
• vibevoice-1.5B: Official Microsoft model (2.7B params, ~5.4GB) - Faster, 90-min generation
• vibevoice-7B: Community preview (9.3B params, ~18GB) - Better quality, 45-min generation
• kugelaudio-0-open: KugelAudio Multilingual (7B, ~18GB) - 23 European languages support
• kugel-2: KugelAudio v2 merged variant (7B, ~18.7GB) - newer Kugel export, same Kugel fallback rules
• vibevoice-hindi-1.5B: Hindi finetune (2.7B params, ~5.4GB) - Optimized for Hindi
• vibevoice-hindi-7B: Hindi finetune (9B params, ~18GB) - Best Hindi quality

All support long-form generation. Note: KugelAudio uses auto-fallback for multi-speaker.

device.tooltip:
Computation device:
• auto: Automatically select best available (MPS on Apple Silicon, CUDA on NVIDIA, XPU on Intel, CPU fallback)
• cuda: Force GPU (requires NVIDIA GPU, ~7GB VRAM)
• xpu: Intel GPU acceleration (requires Intel PyTorch XPU)
• cpu: Force CPU processing (slower)
• mps: Apple Metal Performance Shaders (Apple Silicon Macs only)

Recommended: 'auto' for automatic selection.

quantize_llm_4bit.tooltip:
🗜️ 4-bit LLM quantization (requires bitsandbytes):
• False: Full precision (better quality, faster with sufficient VRAM)
• True: 4-bit quantization (significant VRAM savings)

💾 VRAM Trade-offs:
• 7B model: 12GB → 7.6GB VRAM savings
• 1.5B model: 8.7GB → 3.2GB VRAM savings
• ⚡ Speed: Faster if model doesn't fit in VRAM, slower if it does
• 🎯 Recommended: Only enable if you need VRAM savings

Only quantizes LLM component, diffusion stays full precision.

attention_mode.tooltip:
Attention implementation:
• auto: 🎯 RECOMMENDED - Automatically select best available
• eager: Standard attention (safest, slower)
• sdpa: PyTorch SDPA optimized (balanced)
• flash_attention_2: Fastest but may cause issues on some GPUs
• sage: 🚀 SageAttention - GPU-optimized mixed-precision (INT8/FP16/FP8)
  Requires sageattention package and CUDA GPU (SM80+)
  2-4x faster for long sequences, automatic GPU kernel selection

Auto mode selects: sage > flash_attention_2 > sdpa based on availability.

multi_speaker_mode.tooltip:
Speaker generation mode - SUPPORTS BOTH FORMATS!

• Custom Character Switching: ⭐ RECOMMENDED - Use [Alice], [Bob] character tags. Each character generated separately with voice files from voices folder. Supports pause tags, per-character control, unlimited characters.

• Native Multi-Speaker: ✅ TWO FORMAT OPTIONS:
  1. [Alice], [Bob] tags → auto-converted to Speaker format
  2. Manual 'Speaker 1: Hello
Speaker 2: Hi there' format

Up to 4 speakers. More efficient single-pass generation.

🔧 PRIORITY: Connected speaker2_voice/3/4 inputs override character aliases with warnings!

cfg_scale.tooltip:
Classifier-free guidance scale:
• 1.0: Minimal guidance
• 1.3: Conservative guidance
• 3.0: 🎯 RECOMMENDED - Optimal balance (fewer steps needed)
• 5.0: Strong guidance

Higher CFG allows fewer inference steps while maintaining quality. CFG 3.0 + 3 steps often outperforms CFG 1.3 + 20 steps.

inference_steps.tooltip:
🔄 Diffusion inference steps:
• 3: 🎯 RECOMMENDED - Fast with high CFG (3.0)
• 5-10: Fast but may need lower CFG
• 15-25: Traditional balanced approach
• 30+: Higher quality but slower

With CFG 3.0, just 3 steps often produces better results than CFG 1.3 + 20 steps.

use_sampling.tooltip:
Sampling mode:
• False: 🎯 RECOMMENDED - Deterministic generation for consistency
• True: Sampling with temperature/top_p for more variation

Deterministic mode provides more reliable results.

temperature.tooltip:
🌡️ Generation temperature (only with sampling):
• 0.1-0.5: Very conservative
• 0.8-1.0: 🎯 Natural variation
• 1.2-2.0: More creative but less stable

Only used when use_sampling is True.

top_p.tooltip:
🎯 Nucleus sampling (only with sampling):
• 0.5-0.7: Focused vocabulary
• 0.9-0.95: 🎯 RECOMMENDED - Balanced
• 1.0: Full vocabulary

Only used when use_sampling is True.

chunk_minutes.tooltip:
⏱️ Time-based chunking (OVERRIDES TTS Text chunking settings):
• 0: Disabled - uses TTS Text node chunking settings
• 5-10: Good for memory efficiency
• 15-30: Balance between quality and memory

When > 0, ignores TTS Text enable_chunking and max_chars_per_chunk. Converted to ~750 chars/min internally.

max_new_tokens.tooltip:
🔤 Maximum generation tokens:
• 0: Auto (let model decide)
• 1000-2000: Short content
• 10000-20000: Medium content
• 30000-65536: Long-form content

Safety limit to prevent runaway generation. 0 recommended for auto.

speaker2_voice.tooltip:
🎤 Voice for Speaker 2 in Native Multi-Speaker mode. Connect audio input or Character Voices output.

⚠️ Important: Each speaker must use a DIFFERENT voice file - duplicate voices cause confusion.

💡 Note: Speaker 1 is the 'opt_narrator' input on the Unified TTS Text/SRT node.

speaker3_voice.tooltip:
🎤 Voice for Speaker 3 in Native Multi-Speaker mode. Connect audio input or Character Voices output.

⚠️ Important: Each speaker must use a DIFFERENT voice file - duplicate voices cause confusion.

💡 Note: Speaker 1 is the 'opt_narrator' input on the Unified TTS Text/SRT node.

speaker4_voice.tooltip:
🎤 Voice for Speaker 4 in Native Multi-Speaker mode. Connect audio input or Character Voices output.

⚠️ Important: Each speaker must use a DIFFERENT voice file - duplicate voices cause confusion.

💡 Note: Speaker 1 is the 'opt_narrator' input on the Unified TTS Text/SRT node.

runtime_mode.tooltip:
IMPORTANT: VibeVoice/Kugel usually needs an isolation runtime now.

Runtime Isolation:
• Main Environment: Use the main ComfyUI Python environment
• Shared Runtime: Use the shared secondary legacy runtime for compatible engines
• Dedicated Runtime: Create a separate secondary runtime just for VibeVoice/Kugel

Why this matters:
• The main ComfyUI env is on Transformers 5
• VibeVoice/Kugel still depends on the older pinned stack
